decisions.reason: Product A was launched only in 2023 and already has its own dedicated web page, a sign of strategic commitment. There is no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search, so a small established firm would keep the line while it builds its market position.

Product B is a hyaluronic acid serum, a popular category, but the website only mentions it, which suggests less commitment. Still, it is too early to judge it against aspirations, and keeping a low-cost line extension needs little slack.

Product C is a basic cleansing milk that rounds out the facial care range and costs little to carry. With only one year of results and no clear performance gap, management would likely keep it rather than search for other uses of the resources.
